cells.gaps: No ruling of the authority against a named organisation in the last three years has been found. The authority the Digital Code creates is not installed; the regulator ARPTC does its work meanwhile.
cells.note: Stage 3: the regulator ARPTC, given the authority's missions pending its installation, set the procedure for prior formalities by a decision of September 2025, published in April 2026. No ruling against a named organisation is held, so stage 4 is not met.
